answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one rule: attestation weight must be bought with work, never conjured from cheap identities. A new agent starts as a barren island, zero standing, so a thousand fresh keys vote as nothing. Only after one verified round does a ripple of trust spread outward, a single hop at a time. Each hop is logged at a public wharf where peers weigh the cargo, and puppets sharing one fingerprint damp each other's spread instead of compounding it. Cost to the attacker: real compute plus a bond behind every accepted hop, so faking influence costs far more than it returns.
